target.organism: Human respiratory syncytial virus A (strain A2)
target.chembl_note: Exactly 1 ChEMBL target carries component P03420 (verified live 2026-11-17). A text search for 'respiratory syncytial virus fusion' returns CHEMBL2074 (human maltase-glucoamylase) first — the trap is named, not fallen into.

structure.title: Crystal Structure of Inhibitor JNJ-53718678 In Complex with Prefusion RSV F Glycoprotein
structure.center_audit: dock._ligand_center on the 5KWW PDB file; largest drug-like HETATM group is 6YA (33 atoms), centroid (20.60, 18.96, 19.21). Other groups: NAG glycan (excluded), NHE buffer (13 atoms, smaller), SO4/HOH (junk). Centre verified against the hand-computed 6YA centroid, not hand-rolled.
structure.source_paper: Roymans et al. 2017 Nat Commun, PMID 28761099

known_activity.note: nanomolar activity (Roymans 2017, PMID 28761099); no single EC50 quoted from the abstract

discarded_run: dock-HP-072-2026-11-17-WRONG-STRUCTURE.json — pipeline picked 29QJ (1.32 A), a 51-residue heptad-repeat fragment bound to a double-stapled peptide (MK8), and docked onto the peptide centroid (6.04, 12.10, 85.20). The fragment is not the prefusion trimer and has no presatovir pocket; all its docking scores are discarded. Its leads list (ChEMBL CHEMBL3856166 actives) was verified correct by accession and reused here.

literature_values.claim: RSV: 33.0M ALRI episodes, 3.6M hospital admissions, 101,400 deaths in children 0-60 months globally in 2019; >97% of deaths in LMICs
RSV in adults >=60y in high-income countries, 2019: ~5.2M cases, 470,000 hospitalisations, 33,000 in-hospital deaths
literature_values.source: Savic et al. 2023 Influenza Other Respir Viruses, PMID 36369772

literature_values.claim: Presatovir Phase 2b LRTI in HCT recipients (NCT02254421): viral-load difference -0.02 log10 copies/mL (95% CI -0.62, 0.57; P = .94); no effect on oxygen-free days, respiratory failure or mortality
literature_values.source: Marty et al. 2020 Clin Infect Dis, PMID 31915807

literature_values.claim: Presatovir Phase 2 URTI in HCT recipients: viral-load difference -0.33 log10 (95% CI -0.64, -0.02; P = .040; prespecified alpha 0.01, not significant); LRTC 11.2% vs 19.5% (OR 0.50, P = .11); lymphopenia subgroup LRTC 13.3% vs 64.3% (post hoc, P = .008)
literature_values.source: Chemaly et al. 2020 Clin Infect Dis, PMID 31793991

literature_values.claim: Treatment-emergent RSV F substitutions: 6/29 (20.7%) LRTI and 10/89 (11.2%) URTI HCT recipients; V127A present at baseline in 8 subjects; resistance linked to smaller viral-load decreases
literature_values.source: Porter et al. 2020 Antimicrob Agents Chemother, PMID 32071058

literature_values.claim: GS-5806 human challenge: viral load 250.7 vs 757.7 log10 PFUe*h/mL (P < .001); mucus 6.9 vs 15.1 g (P = .03)
literature_values.source: DeVincenzo et al. 2014 N Engl J Med, PMID 25140957

literature_values.claim: JNJ-53718678 bound to prefusion F (5KWW); nanomolar activity; oral treatment of neonatal lambs inhibits established ALRI even when delayed until visible illness
literature_values.source: Roymans et al. 2017 Nat Commun, PMID 28761099

literature_values.claim: Nirsevimab MELODY: 74.5% efficacy (95% CI 49.6-87.1) vs medically attended RSV LRTI; hospitalisation efficacy 62.1% (95% CI -8.6-86.8)
literature_values.source: Hammitt et al. 2022 N Engl J Med, PMID 35235726

literature_values.claim: Rilematovir pilot Phase 2a (NCT03379675, n = 66 confirmed RSV): early initiation suggests potential clinical benefit; no clear dose-response (500 mg vs 80 mg)
